questions.translation: 人格心理学家把经验开放性分成两个子因子：开放与智性。开放子因子高的人往往有更多艺术创造成就，而智性高的人在艺术与科学两方面都往往有更多创造成就。作者推断，Simon Ramo 的经验开放性中，智性维度一定很高，因为他探索并创造性解决了各种工程问题；Louis Cha 的开放维度一定很高，因为他过着情感丰富、富于想象的人生。

evidence.quote: Personality psychologists have classified openness to experience into two subfactors: openness and intellect. People high in openness tend to have more creative accomplishments in the arts, whereas people high in intellect tend to have more creative accomplishments both in arts and sciences. Simon Ramo must have been high in the intellect dimension of openness to experience, as he explored and found many creative solutions to diverse engineering problems, while Louis Cha must have been high in the openness dimension, as he led an emotionally rich, imaginative life.
